svg.title: Atlas architecture diagram
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture: React frontend on Vercel, FastAPI backend on Render, PostgreSQL on Neon, with external integrations to Anthropic Claude API, Google Calendar, Canvas LMS, Stripe, SendGrid, Resend, and Web Push.
svg.text: React · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Anthropic Claude · Vercel · Render · Neon
Raw SQL · psycopg2 · no ORM · init_db() auto-setup
